stories.title: Refactor verification middleware for soft block
stories.acceptance_criteria: requireEmailVerified allows unverified through. New requireEmailVerifiedForManager returns 403 for unverified. Apply to users, shifts, export, audit routes only. Clock, timesheet, auth remain accessible.

stories.title: Include email_verified in auth/me response
stories.acceptance_criteria: GET /api/auth/me returns venue.email_verified (boolean) so client can show banner and disable manager UI.

stories.title: Banner and disabled manager UI for unverified
stories.acceptance_criteria: When venue.email_verified is false: show banner 'Verify your email to add staff and manage shifts'; disable Add User, Manage Users actions, shift add/edit/delete, export. Employee clock and timesheet work.

stories.title: Final verification
stories.acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes. verify script passes. Unverified can login, clock, view timesheet; cannot add user; banner visible.
